PRACTICAL BUDAPEST EXAMPLES

Targeted search campaigns in practice.

The power of Google Ads lies in narrowing spend strictly to commercial intent. These scenarios illustrate how focused budgets deliver qualified enquiries across diverse Budapest sectors.

EXAMPLE 01 · DISTRICT XIII

Corporate legal consultancy

Starting point: Broad keywords wasted budget on searches for free legal advice and standard template downloads without client retention.

Actions taken: Implementing a strict negative list and targeting high-value commercial matters: property conveyancing, company bylaws and corporate representation.

Outcome: 40% reduction in cost per consultation enquiry and a significant rise in qualified business clients.

EXAMPLE 02 · DISTRICTS XI & XXII

HVAC & heat pump installation

Starting point: Summer seasonal budget quickly drained from DIY hobbyists seeking cheap spare parts.

Actions taken: Narrowing focus strictly to complete system installations, paired with mobile click-to-call ads targeting property owners in South Buda.

Outcome: Generating 18 to 22 qualified on-site survey requests each week throughout the peak season.

EXAMPLE 03 · DISTRICTS II & XII

High-end residential renovation

Starting point: Influx of minor handyman requests burdened management time instead of large-scale apartment modernisations.

Actions taken: Refined copy establishing project thresholds, targeting affluent Buda hill districts and linking to an upfront pricing guide.

Outcome: Higher lead quality, efficient site visits and 3 major execution contracts signed in the first quarter.

BOUNDARIES AND TRANSPARENCY

Working parameters and Quality Score

Media spend paid to Google is a separate cost billed directly to your payment card. We do not promise guaranteed customer numbers, and campaigns launch only after agreed budgets are defined. Effective operation is built on maintaining high Google Quality Scores.

Frequently asked questions

What monthly ad spend is recommended to start?

For local service businesses in Budapest, an initial test budget of 80,000 to 150,000 HUF per month is usually enough to identify which keywords generate genuine enquiries.

What is the difference between management fees and ad spend?

Ad spend is billed directly by Google for impressions and clicks, while our service fee covers campaign planning, setup, tracking and ongoing weekly optimisation.

How do we prevent wasted clicks?

We protect your budget using comprehensive negative keyword lists, tight geographic radiuses and excluding broad terms that only seek free information.

Why is a dedicated landing page important for Ads?

When visitors click an ad and land on a generic or cluttered homepage, they leave immediately. Directing ad clicks to a focused quotation page increases conversion significantly.

How does Quality Score lower our cost per click?

Google rates the relevance of keywords, ad copy and landing pages on a scale of 1 to 10. High Quality Scores earn higher ad positions even with lower bid prices compared to competitors.

How quickly can a campaign launch and generate enquiries?

Once strategy and ad copy are approved, campaigns can launch within 24 to 48 hours. Because Google Search captures existing commercial demand, relevant enquiries can begin arriving in the first week.
